faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: Yes. You can create short links for free without an account. Sign up to manage links and see analytics.
faq.a2: Not unless you set an expiry date or a click limit in the advanced options.
faq.q3: Can I choose my own slug?
faq.a3: Yes. A slug has 3–32 characters: letters, digits, underscore or hyphen, as long as it is not taken.
faq.q4: How do I see click statistics?
faq.a4: Sign in and open the dashboard to see clicks by day, referrer and device.
faq.a5: A preview page lets visitors see the destination before continuing. We reject URLs that point back to this service.
faq.q6: Can I delete or disable a link?
faq.a6: Yes. You can disable or delete your links at any time from the dashboard.
